DMT Rainbow
At the beginning of this year, me and a group of friends made the pilgrimage to Byron Bay for New Year's Eve. After a trip to nearby Nimbin and many bongs, we returned to our campsite to find a group of our friends engaged in a session with couple of locals. But they werent smoking weed.
I was very interested and enquired what it was. It was DMT dissolved in smokable herbs. We became very excited and managed to buy $50 worth. I decided to try a cone right then. It was a bright sunny day and sat down on the grass cross legged and relaxed. I packed it into the glassie nice and firmly and I was getting a butterflies after seeing my friend smoke and enter his own world. I punched it down and held the smoke in for as long as possible as I was instructed and then exhaled. Practically straight away I got a warm tingle up my back and spine and I relaxed completely. I could feel tears roll down my face but I had absolutely no control.
At first I didnt realise I was tripping but I began to realise the tint of my vision was continually changing, from green to blue to red to yellow etc. It was complete euphoria and I could feel my body completely
It was complete euphoria and I could feel my body completely
and it felt as if my body was getting really heavy then really light and that the weight of my body was just flowing through me, up and down. I then lay back and relaxed even more in my euphoria and looked at the sky which looked like a rainbow of colours with little four clover flowers hanging like stars. I was amazed and very happy as I hadnt experienced anything like this before.
I peaked like this for about 5-10 minutes and then began to come down. As I was coming down, I experienced a lot of residual effects. The lighter shade of grass began to move snakelike through the darker shades  of grass and I asked my friend if he saw it as well. He did. These residual effects lasted about another 10mins. Finally my trip finished and I smoked some more weed.
DMT was the first hallucinogenic I tried and I loved it. Over the next week in Byron, I smoked many more cones of it.  I found that daytime was a more suitable environment for DMT as it brings out the colours more however, the closed eye trips are much more enhanced in the dark.
Each dose I had was about a level cone as I found any bigger was very intense on my body, but the trips are still great.
